findings.message:
The following .npmrc file(s) set a package registry, which is not allowed. Remove the registry setting - the build must resolve every dependency from the default public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org). A custom registry pulls the declared package names from an undeclared source, making package.json and the lock file a decoy.
Read more: https://webextension-api.thunderbird.net/en/mv3/guides/sourceCodeSubmission.html
